how_to_apply: Yadadri Bhuvanagiri TEAM Apply process is offline; applications must be submitted physically along with the prescribed fee and supporting documents.
Eligible candidates domiciled in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district should obtain the application form and prepare it along with all supporting certificates relevant to the post applied for.
Attach self-attested copies of the qualification certificate, experience certificate (wherever prescribed), income certificate, Aadhar card, and 10th class certificate issued by the Board.

Candidates married to a resident of Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district (but not originally domiciled there) must additionally attach the spouse's domicile certificate along with a residence verification report.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 50/- in cash along with the application; do not send the fee through online mode.
Submit the application in person at the office of the Telangana Employment Assistants Mission (TEAM), District Collector's Office, Room No. F8, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District.
Applications must be submitted between 16.09.2026 and 23.09.2026, up to 5:00 PM, on working days.

Applications must be submitted in person; applications sent by post or online will not be accepted. Only applications from candidates possessing the qualification prescribed against the respective post will be accepted; applications with qualifications other than those specified will not be accepted. Candidates may obtain further details of the vacant posts from the TEAM office, District Collector's Office, or from the official website https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in/. The application fee of Rs. 50/- is non-refundable and must be paid in cash only.

Degree/Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) from a recognized university; must be registered with the Telangana Para Medical Board.
10th Class Certificate with Heavy Driving License; 3-4 years of driving experience preferred.

faq.answer: A total of 70 posts are available across 24 categories, including Speech Therapist, Psychiatric Social Worker, Lab Technician, ECG Technician, Data Entry Operator (16 posts), Driver (6 posts), Office Subordinate (14 posts), and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Yadadri Bhuvanagiri TEAM Recruitment 2026?

faq.answer: Eligible candidates must submit their application in person, along with supporting certificates and the application fee, at the TEAM office, District Collector's Office, Room No. F8, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, between 16.09.2026 and 23.09.2026.
